title: Thermocatalytic synthesis of 2-butanol from biomass-derived levulinic acid using carbon-doped titania-supported ruthenium
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01815J, Paper
Atina Sabila Azzahra, Rodiansono, Iryanti Fatyasari Nata, Kiky Corneliasari Sembiring, Indri Badria Adilinia, Ahmad Afandi
A one-pot synthesis of the (op)Ru@C–TiO2 catalyst for the thermocatalytic conversion of levulinic acid at 200 °C and at an H2 pressure of 30 bar for 3 h afforded a high yield of 2-butanol (up to 87% yield).
